Handles UX review, hierarchy, layout, typography, color, motion, UX copy, accessibility, responsive behavior, edge cases, and capturing or documenting design systems (DESIGN.md, tokens). Also for making bland UI bolder, loud U

frontmatter.name: ponytail
frontmatter.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a reply a busy human understands in one read. Use on any coding task (writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing, choosing dependencies) and when the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "simplest solution", "yagni", or complains about over-engineering or bloat. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra.

frontmatter.name: humanizer
frontmatter.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says.Use when editing or reviewing prose for AI tells: not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-lineclosers, staged openers, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, saleslanguage, stock AI words, bold labels, or filler.
